252    public static function stringStatus(int $status)
253    {
254        switch ($status) {
255            case self::STATUS_DRAFT:
256                return ctrans('texts.draft');
257            case self::STATUS_SENT:
258                return ctrans('texts.sent');
259            case self::STATUS_ACCEPTED:
260                return ctrans('texts.accepted');
261            case self::STATUS_CANCELLED:
262                return ctrans('texts.cancelled');
263            default:
264                return ctrans('texts.sent');
265
266        }
267    }

269    public static function badgeForStatus(int $status)
270    {
271        switch ($status) {
272            case self::STATUS_DRAFT:

395    {

397
398        if ($this->uses_inclusive_taxes) {
